forbidden.comment: Circular dependencies make code unpredictable and hard to test.
forbidden.name: no-circular

forbidden.comment: core/ must not know how it is triggered (no commands, no modules). Invert the dependency or move shared shapes to core/.
forbidden.name: core-no-application

forbidden.comment: core/ may reach infrastructure only through core/interfaces ports; concrete adapters are injected.
forbidden.name: core-no-infrastructure

forbidden.comment: Nothing from main may reach the renderer bundle: the electron package is main/preload only.
forbidden.name: ui-no-electron

forbidden.comment: Nothing from main may reach the renderer bundle: Node built-in modules are unavailable in the renderer.
forbidden.name: ui-no-node-builtins

forbidden.comment: Application layer must not reach into infrastructure adapters. The IPC module is the composition root.
forbidden.name: app-no-infrastructure

forbidden.comment: infrastructure/ adapters must not import application/ or core/services — they may implement core/interfaces and return core/domain types.
forbidden.name: infrastructure-no-upward-deps

forbidden.comment: cli.ts runs on Electron in Node mode (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE), where the electron package is only the binary path: nothing it reaches may import electron.
forbidden.name: cli-no-electron

forbidden.comment: Every module in src must be reachable from an entry point (dead-code guard; allow type declarations).
forbidden.name: no-unreachable-from-entry

forbidden.comment: Orphan modules are dead-code candidates (allow type declarations and entry points).
forbidden.name: no-orphans

forbidden.comment: Production code must not import devDependencies (type-only imports are compiled away and allowed).
forbidden.name: not-to-dev-dep

forbidden.comment: Every import from src must resolve to a dependency declared in package.json.
forbidden.name: no-non-package-json

forbidden.comment: The renderer talks to the main process only through window.fly.
forbidden.name: no-ui-to-main

forbidden.comment: The renderer may import core/domain as types only.
forbidden.name: ui-domain-type-only

forbidden.comment: infrastructure may import core/interfaces and core/domain, never core/services.
forbidden.name: no-infra-to-core-services
